LanguageData.LP_Make_BabyFoodMeat.label: make baby food from meat
LanguageData.LP_Make_BabyFoodMeat.description: Mince raw meat and boil it soft into mush for babies. The product is vanilla baby food, just no longer vegetarian: it remembers what meat was used, and adults forced to eat it get moods per meat and cannibalism precepts as usual. Uses only raw meat by default (no human or insect meat); vegetables, milk and eggs can be ticked in the bill to mix in.
LanguageData.LP_Make_BabyFoodMeat.ingredients.0.filte: raw meat or other raw ingredients
